BACKGROUND

A little background

In the single’s notes, ESEGYE say the song holds the three things that mattered most to them at 21, and the hope that it would be all right not to find answers about them.

  • Bugs — Cry For Me / RomanceYouthLove notes and credits (Korean) ↗

INSIDE THE LYRICS

Setting off without a destination

  • Youth
  • Shared uncertainty

Romance, youth and love become boats in this song’s central image: things that can carry two people somewhere together. Their destination stays unknown. The repeated reassurance draws its confidence from companionship, even as the lyric admits how little they know.

That admission keeps the optimism a little reckless. Youth appears as a willingness to depart before having an answer, with another person close enough to share the uncertainty. The promise depends on their togetherness; the world ahead has offered no guarantees.

ABOUT THE ARTIST / 이세계

ESEGYE

ESEGYE is a Korean band writing about feelings people often keep to themselves. Their name points to another world.

The band began releasing music in 2020. “RomanceYouthLove” appeared on their debut double single that June.
